description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling regional endpoints configuration for STS (Security Token Service). It provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, ini files, or fallback defaults, and supports caching of configurations.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A class that provides various configuration sources for AWS STS regional endpoints, allowing for environment-based, ini-based, and fallback configurations, with caching support.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Provides configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when no other sources are set.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates configuration from a specified ini file and profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts a configuration object, promise, string, or array into a ConfigurationInterface instance.
